comment: HS mapping vs declared 071220/071290/200811/200819: PARTIAL. Correctly covered: dehydrated onion (071220) and dehydrated garlic/other dried vegetables (071290) - the core of the declared range; peanut butter & peanuts (200811) and other prepared nuts/seeds (200819) are plausible for the 'Peanut Butter & Peanuts' line. Missing from the declaration: (1) Garlic & Ginger Paste - a wet paste, not a dried vegetable, so 0712 is wrong for it; most likely 200190 or 200599; (2) Fried Onion - a cooked/prepared product, most likely 200599 or 200190, definitely not 0712; (3) Fresh Onion & Garlic - 070310 / 070320, a separate chapter entirely; (4) 'All Spices' - chapter 09 (0904-0910), no declared code covers it. So the declared set covers only the dehydrated-onion/garlic core and the peanut line, and omits at least three real product families (fresh produce, pastes, fried onion, spices). Industry classification 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is broadly correct but imprecise: the company is a dehydrated vegetable/ingredient processor (B2B ingredient supplier), not an FMCG brand owner - no consumer packaged brand found on site. Trader signs: none observed; site presents own manufacturing unit, so role is manufacturer, but this is self-declared only. Per project rule 3, the HS gaps are NOT grounds for rejection - company stays in the base with corrected codes and verdict accepted_hs_corrected. All product claims here are 'заявлено, не подтверждено': no customs line, B-L or GST record was checked in this review (out of scope), and no product sub-page could be loaded to confirm SKUs. Revenue, export volume, PAN, CIN, registration data: null - not researched in this role and not public on the pages read.
